name: 象牙黑金
author: Shinji
tagline: 三上悠亚写真 · 象牙黑金 · 冷调胶片
taglineEn: Yua Mikami portraits, ivory noir and a film-grain chill
description: 以三上悠亚写真为素材的暗调皮肤：象牙表面、酒红强调、黑裙竖幅主视觉、冷调胶片质感与同脸系图标。
descriptionEn: A dark, film-toned portrait skin built from Yua Mikami photography: ivory surfaces, wine-red accents, a black-dress hero portrait and a matching icon family.
